Ranked Modern Warfare aimbot works better with smooth tracking than instant snaps that get you reported. [Pro tier](/products/mw4-cheats/) at buymw4cheats.com ships Bone Priority, Prediction, Smoothness sliders, and Hotkey macros modules tuned for high ranked lobbies.
This setup guide gets you from download to first safe Ranked session without max settings that fail in replays.
Start with portal Ranked presets

Load the Ranked preset in your operator portal before customizing. Presets use high aim smoothness, chest-priority targeting on players that need it, and Hotkey macros disabled until you enable heal and mobility macros manually once per game to learn timings.
Save a copy as my_Ranked before edits—mode preset can diverge with lower delays without corrupting Ranked safety.
Prediction and Bone Priority
Prediction leads moving targets for skill chains, interrupts, or ranged finishers. Bone Priority picks the lowest HP player in range or focus-fire call target.
Set selector to prefer stun targets for supports—healers and controllers—not random nearest bot. DPS profiles prefer lowest HP target in script range.
Hotkey macros for clutch items
Bind Hotkey macros to fire shield potion before script combo when three enemies are within radius, or shield on channeling castors. Add 80–120 ms delay so item use precedes peeks naturally.
Overlapping instant heals plus instant aim snaps looks robotic in replays—review one replay weekly with conservative settings.
per-weapon aimbot profiles
Save separate profiles for staff, bow, and gun—examples in [Weapon aimbot guide](/blog/mw4-aimbot-combat-guide/). Hotkey swap in player select without reopening loader.
mode preset can use lower delays; Ranked preset stays conservative until you have ten clean games at current delay values.
Patch day and anti-cheat discipline
After every Modern Warfare update, run [Ricochet patch day checklist](/blog/ricochet-patch-day-checklist/) before Ranked. Script offsets break silently—bot lobby verify combo fire before rank.
Read buymw4cheats.com status banner; yellow means wait even if yesterday’s session was clean.
